$comment: Scoring definition. finalScore = judgeWeight*judgeScore + deterministicWeight*deterministicScore + agentWeight*agentScore. Weights are renormalized over whichever sources are available. Judge scores are 0-10 and scaled to 0-100.

criteria.label: Search intent match
criteria.guidance: Does the article fully answer what someone searching this title wants? Covers the practical questions, next steps, and decision points.

criteria.label: On-page SEO
criteria.guidance: Title and meta description length/quality, keyword placement in title, first paragraph, and at least one H2, descriptive H2s suitable for featured snippets, no keyword stuffing.

criteria.label: Structure and readability
criteria.guidance: Logical H2/H3 hierarchy, short paragraphs, bullet lists, scannable sections, clear transitions, appropriate length.

criteria.label: Depth and factual accuracy
criteria.guidance: Topical depth, concrete legal detail (law references, durations, conditions, exceptions), consistent internal logic, no fabricated citations or obviously wrong facts.

criteria.label: E-E-A-T and legal neutrality
criteria.guidance: Professional, experience-informed tone. Legally neutral: no guaranteed outcomes, no promises of winning, no definitive-prediction language. Appropriate disclaimers where needed.

criteria.label: Persuasiveness and CTA
criteria.guidance: Reader is guided toward a sensible next step (consultation/contact) without pressure, with a relevant and non-spammy call to action.

criteria.label: Originality
criteria.guidance: Concrete, non-generic content. Avoids boilerplate filler, repetitive phrasing, and copy-paste structure that adds no value.

checks.label: Keyword in at least one H2
